infoPlist.NSLocalNetworkUsageDescription: Apex Factory downloads new features from the Callstack booth laptop on this Wi-Fi network.
infoPlist.NSCameraUsageDescription: Apex Factory uses the camera for booth features you try, like scanning a QR code or taking a photo. Nothing is uploaded.

plugins.photosPermission: Apex Factory opens your photo library only when you pick a photo for a booth feature you try.
plugins.cameraPermission: Apex Factory uses the camera for booth features you try, like scanning a QR code or taking a photo. Nothing is uploaded.

plugins.photosPermission: Apex Factory opens your photo library only when you pick a photo for a booth feature you try.
plugins.savePhotosPermission: Apex Factory saves pictures you create in a booth feature to your photo library.

plugins.locationWhenInUsePermission: Apex Factory uses your location while the app is open, for booth features you try such as showing where you are on a map.
plugins.motionUsagePermission: Apex Factory reads motion sensors (steps, movement) for booth features you try, such as a step counter.

plugins.calendarPermission: Apex Factory reads and adds calendar events only for booth features you try, such as saving a reactCon session to your calendar.
